name: arya-native
compiler: Self-hosted Arya frontend, C11 ahead-of-time backend, native managed value runtime

build.fullSourceSDK: core tools plus C++20 for Ada URL and Perl for OpenSSL configuration

language: records with shorthand fields, string computed keys and shallow record spread
flow-sensitive gradual types with array, record, function, union and promise contracts
native source locations and stack traces

decimal.values: Immutable parsed values: parse, format, add, subtract, multiply, compare, divide, quantize, toNumber, remainder. Remainder uses a quotient truncated toward zero. libmpdec owns exact coefficients; public layout remains opaque.

optionalDependencies.python: An explicit Python import/call needs a separately installed Python interpreter. Core compilation/execution never launches it. Windows/Cygwin Python interoperability is unsupported in 2.0.0 and raises ARYA_PYTHON_PLATFORM before process launch.
optionalDependencies.mysql: A separately installed MySQL C client SDK selected by ARYA_MYSQL_PREFIX; not bundled. Prepared statements, exact DECIMAL/BIGINT strings and bounded pools.
optionalDependencies.desktop: macOS AppKit/WebKit system frameworks, linked only by explicit desktop imports.
optionalDependencies.gui: Direct native controls, linked only by explicit gui imports: AppKit/Cocoa on macOS, GTK 3 on Linux, Win32 user32/gdi32/comctl32 on Windows. Windows Cygwin builds additionally depend on cygwin1.dll; a standalone MinGW runtime is not qualified. See docs/native-gui.md for measured platform status.
optionalDependencies.auth: OpenSSL for authentication primitives; on macOS, Foundation/LocalAuthentication/Security for biometric policies and device-local access-controlled Keychain credentials. Other hosts fail closed for local authentication and vault operations.
optionalDependencies.editor: Separate optional VSIX executes JavaScript transport in the editor host. Standalone SDK excludes it; native LSP requires no JavaScript engine.

limits.gui: 16 live windows, 128 controls/window, 256 queued events/window, 1000 items/select or list, 16384 UTF-16 units/editable text. Direct label/button/input/textarea/checkbox/select/list/progress widgets; fixed geometry with resize events, one pending nextEvent/window. No browser or WebKit dependency.
limits.auth: Process-local opaque stores: at most 65536 entries, 1-2592000 second sessions and 1-3600 second challenges. TOTP: SHA1/SHA256/SHA512, 6/8 digits, 15-120 second period, at most two adjacent steps each side. macOS native credentials: 16384 UTF-8 bytes; one active local operation per process, cancellable with 1-120000 ms deadlines and native AbortSignal. In-place replacement preserves item access controls. Persistent/distributed storage, provider token exchange and WebAuthn verification are application integrations.
limits.decimal: 4096 context digits; 1024-character canonical input/output; output scales 0–100; nine explicit rounding modes
limits.accounting: 1000000 rows, 100000 accounts, signed 64-bit per-line minor units, checked signed 128-bit products/aggregates, scales 0–6, two active cooperative asynchronous calculations
limits.regex: PCRE2 native semantics, no JIT, bounded execution; not a full ECMAScript engine
limits.csv: 65536 UTF-16 units per push; defaults: field 65536 units, record 1048576 units, 1024 columns; field/record configurable up to 1048576, columns up to 1024; readChunk 1–1048576 input bytes plus at most three carried UTF-8 bytes
limits.json: 16 Mi UTF-16 input units, 16 MiB UTF-8 output, 100000 value nodes and depth 128; JSON-lines io.readLine frames are 1 MiB
limits.money: Explicit three-letter uppercase currency tag, scale 0–100 and explicit rounding; exact parsed amount with decimal bounds
limits.finance: 100000 rows/periods, two active cooperative prepared calculations, 4096-row cancellation chunks; decimal bounds for all intermediates

compatibility.nodePackageImports: use js / Node packages and JavaScript module emission remain in the retained 1.3 implementation; native code uses Arya modules or explicit foreign protocols.
compatibility.hostGlobals: Native Object/Array/Map/Set/Date/Buffer/AbortSignal compatibility APIs are bounded subsets, documented in docs/native-profile.md.
compatibility.ledger: No Ledger project, installed package, database or data was modified. Existing pinned 1.3 installations remain separate. The native JSON-lines financial worker is an opt-in integration path.

nativeDataOptimizations.status: implemented; local Darwin ARM64 candidate qualification; not a platform release claim
compiler: guarded field offsets with generic fallback
runtime: bounded JSON string scratch and unescaped fast path
checked decimal integer operations with libmpdec fallback
bounded line reads with one stdio lock per frame
diagnostics: content and dependency aware native run cache

measurement.scope: Frozen local snapshot; later working-tree changes are separate

distribution: Standalone SDK contains native tooling and no .js/.cjs/.mjs/.vsix tool files. Optional browser UI/desktop content and Python interoperability retain explicit external host requirements.

syntaxUpdate.computedKeys: {[expression]: value} requires a string key, validated before the value expression
syntaxUpdate.recordSpread: {...record} snapshots own stored keys and shallow-copies their current values in Object.keys order; non-record inputs reject
syntaxUpdate.compatibility: Additive syntax; existing canonical fn/let/const/use forms preserved
